paper_metadata.title: Tailoring nanoprecipitates to achieve ultrahigh strength (CoCrNi)94.5W3Ta2.5 medium-entropy alloys

evidence.quote: a novel ultra-strong (CoCrNi)94.5W3Ta2.5 medium entropy alloy (MEA) with dual nanoprecipitates is successfully developed
The as-cast ingots (namely AC) with dimensions of 50 × 30 × 8 mm3 were homogenized at 1573 K for 20 h in an Ar atmosphere followed by water quenching.
The homogenized alloys were then cold-rolled along the longitudinal direction in steps at room temperature (293 K) with a total rolling reduction of 92.5 %, namely CR.
Then, the as-rolled alloys were annealed at 1273 K for 3 min followed by water quenching, namely CRA.
Subsequently, the annealed alloys were aged at 923 K for 100 h followed by water quenching, namely CRAA.
